files.summary: End-to-end tests for extend, remainingSeconds and backward compatibility

note: Proposed tests (11 [Fact] method(s)). Executed only by the orchestrator's sandbox run. Fix for attempt 1: the create endpoint is idempotent per client and target URL (it returns 200 OK for a repeat), so my helper used the same URL for several links per client. Every link now gets a unique URL, and the helper asserts 201 Created. I raised RateLimitPerWindow in the concurrency test so the limiter doesn't return 429. The p95 latency smoke check is not included; this suite has 11 facts. Audit log events are not asserted because test logging is set to Warning.
